allOf.description: Standard response envelope used by all endpoints except getLoyaltyTierDescription

data.description: Response payload on success; error message string on failure

allOf.title: ApiResponse

400.description: The request contains invalid or missing data required for processing.

example.data: Order details are required to process redemption

401.description: Authentication failed. The api_key is invalid, or the JWT Bearer token is invalid or does not match the merchant context.

invalidJwt.summary: JWT token does not match merchant context

404.description: The referenced resource does not exist.

example.data: Loyalty record not found for customer

500.description: An unexpected server-side error occurred. Retry after a brief interval. Contact Qubriux support if the problem persists.

example.data: An internal error occurred. Please try again later.
